missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Воспоминание' is a neuter '-ние' noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Приятное' is the agreeing neuter adjective describing the memory.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Воспоминание' is neuter and inanimate, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'храню'. 'Это' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Воспоминания' takes the genitive after 'от', giving the cause of the sadness. 'Стало грустно' states the emotional result.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Воспоминанию' takes the dative after 'к', expressing a return to the memory. 'Старому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Воспоминанием' takes the instrumental to show what she lives by. 'Одним' agrees in the neuter instrumental, stressing a single memory.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Воспоминании' takes the prepositional after 'в', placing the warmth inside the memory. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Воспоминания' is the genitive after 'нет', stating that no such memory exists. 'Такого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Воспоминания' is the nominative plural subject. 'Детские' and 'самые яркие' agree in the plural, describing childhood memories.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Воспоминаниями' takes the instrumental plural after 'делюсь', which governs that case. 'С друзьями' names the people sharing them.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Воспоминаний' is the genitive plural after 'из', the source of the books. 'Детских' agrees in the genitive plural.
